title: Smoky Haddock alla Italiana
description: Smoky haddock is marinated in a blend of Italian flavors and then baked to perfection, served with a side of garlic roasted vegetables.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a small bowl, mix together curry powder, garlic powder, and dried oregano.
Place the haddock fillets on the prepared baking sheet.
Drizzle the olive oil over the haddock, then sprinkle with the spice mixture.
Squeeze the lemon juice over the haddock.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cooked through.
While the haddock is baking, toss the chopped parsley with a squeeze of lemon juice and a sprinkle of salt.
Serve the haddock with the garlic roasted vegetables and a side of parsley salad.
